payload.description_html: Albertonykus is the earliest and smallest known alvarezsaurid from North America, reaching about 1 m in total body length. Alvarezsaurids are known for their long skinny legs adapted for running, and extremely reduced forelimbs. Albertonykus supports the theory that alvarezsaurs originated in South America and dispersed to Asia through North America.
